name: Jessie Colbert
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2024 session 2 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Jessie Colbert as an author of “Revealing uncertainty through the visualisation of geographically and thematically classified map collections”.

GeoCart 2024 session 3 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Jessie Colbert as an author of “Automating advocacy: developing a geospatial tool for creating local alcohol harm risk profiles”.
GIScience 2025 accepted abstracts, official conference programme lists Jessie Colbert as an author of “Developing a walking accessibility index in urban areas of New Zealand”.
